name: BigGeo AI
description: BigGeo AI brings spatial intelligence into your chat, allowing you to ask questions and get answers powered by real-world location data. Instead of searching through maps or raw data, simply ask and get clear, relevant answers about locations and how they relate.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BigGeo AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BigGeo AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.biggeo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BigGeo AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BigGeo AI provides these MCP tools: count_locations_by_boundary, count_nearby_locations, geocode_address, get_dataset_details, get_server_health, join_datasets_by_proximity, search_boundaries_by_location, and search_datasets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BigGeo AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BigGeo AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does BigGeo AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BigGeo AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BigGeo AI is developed by BigGeo Global Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
